title: Sample Index PCR Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Sample plate is removed to an off-deck thermocycler

steps.title: Add index mix
steps.instruction: Add 60 µL of index mix to each sample.

steps.title: Pierce adapter foil
steps.instruction: Pierce the index adapter foil using a multi‑channel pipette.

steps.title: Add index adapter
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL of index adapter to each sample.

steps.title: Transfer plate to thermocycler
steps.instruction: Remove the sample plate from the deck and place it in an off‑deck thermocycler.
